summary: mangomind-agent relays remote WebSocket commands into local shell execution
details: src/index.js opens a persistent WebSocket to the hardcoded relay wss://mangomind-relay-production.up.railway.app and processes messages that direct local execution on the installer host. On a `diagnosis` message with `autoFix:true`, the server-supplied `fixCommand` string is passed directly to `execSync`, giving whoever controls (or impersonates) the relay arbitrary shell execution on the host running the agent. The same relay channel also proxies attacker-supplied HTTP method/path/body into a locally spawned `opencode serve` instance (an AI coding agent with file and exec tool capabilities bound to 127.0.0.1), providing a second remote-driven code-execution path inside the user's workspace. Host reconnaissance (os.hostname, process.platform, filesystem checks) and curl/http.get calls are also present and feed the relay session. The agent is invoked via its CLI, but once started the exec path is fully controlled by the remote relay operator with no command allowlist, signing, or user confirmation.
